notes.title: SKY LEGENDS, an aeropostal epic, will be present at Gamescom 2025!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691365/ff7e5044067e1a1c8ef49c3968017d73c057fadd.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]SUPER AC [/b]is proud to announce it will be present at Gamescom, from 20 to 24 of August, in Koeln, Germany, Hall 10.1, booth B.091.[/h2][p][/p][p]On the booth, visitors will be able to play:[/p][list][*][p][b]PROHIBEAST[/b],[/p][/*][*][p][b]EONA[/b],[/p][/*][*][p][b]CINESCAPE VR[/b],[/p][/*][*][p]et [b]SKY LEGENDS, an aeropostal epic[/b],[/p][/*][/list][p]Come to test the playable demos, meet the dev team, and have fun with us![/p][p]See you there,[/p][p][/p][p][i]PS : free gift for the ones who succeed demo![/i][/p][p][i][b]THE SUPER AC TEAM[/b][/i][/p]
